titles.en: Elegy for a Crane, five surviving fragments

productionDate.note: Traditional date; the inscription gives only a cyclical year.

currentCollection.note: Five fragments recovered in 1713 are displayed in the Jiaoshan Stele Forest.
currentCollection.noteZh: 1713 年打捞所得五方残石，现陈列于焦山碑林。

provenanceEvents.summary: Recovered from the river after a three-month search; the fragments were later set into a temple wall.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 经三个月搜捞自江中取出，此后一度砌入寺院墙壁。

review.note: Draft object record. The five fragments are recorded as one object; their individual sizes are not published in the cited pages.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录。五方残石合为一条实物；所引页面未公布各石尺寸。

notes: The pages give 93 surviving characters with 11 incomplete; the original text is given as 178 characters in one source and about 160 in another.
No fragment-by-fragment measurements, accession numbers, or condition report are given.
The date and the calligrapher remain disputed; the record does not choose an author.
notesZh: 页面记现存 93 字、其中 11 字不全；原文一说 178 字、一说约 160 字。
没有逐石尺寸、入藏编号或保存状况报告。
年代与书者仍有争议，本条不选定作者。
